title: The Azure Net-Bearers' Course
summary: The school course of the net-bearers that runs from the light cast net to the sky-wide net drawn tight on every soul.

title: Manual of the Hawk's Descent
summary: The school manual of the hawk that hangs its snares high and lets them fall the whole way on the soul below.

title: Canon of the Azure Apex Gaoler
summary: The school canon of the apex gaoler whose Core-fed snares are planted inside a soul as readily as in open air.

title: The Wind-Sworn Gin Course
summary: The school course of the wind-sworn that links toothed gins across the air until they close together as one maw.

title: Manual of the Oath Held Taut
summary: The school manual of cords drawn taut and never slackened that ends in every cord in range pulled tight at once.

title: Canon of the Sworn Zenith Snare
summary: The school canon of the zenith snare that gathers the full reach of the soul onto one chosen soul that cannot slip it.
